items.name: The operator starts a run, and it performs the cycle's effects up to the score
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: The HTTP fixture passed its cycle and recorded the eleven specified effects in order, including gate-attempt-passed.

items.name: A run identity is started once
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: After R-1 failed at fence, a second start using R-1 was refused run-already-started; the run list held R-1 once with C-1.

items.name: A second run is refused while the first is running
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: While the builder slept, R-2 was refused run-in-progress, its progress was null, and R-1 remained running.

items.name: A cycle is run once
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: After R-1 passed, a start of R-2 using C-1 was refused cycle-already-run, and R-2 progress returned null.

items.name: A run of something that is not a commit of the project repository is refused
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: Started R-1 with a nonexistent 40-hex commit; start-run refused not-a-commit and run-progress returned null. No builder was configured or launched.

items.name: A checklist Measurement refuses halts the run with Measurement's refusal
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: An empty fixture plan yielded a checklist refusal empty-checklist and a halt at checklist before the cycle; no self-check or fence effect appeared.

items.name: A plan whose item identities a fresh stamp does not give back halts the run before the cycle
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: A fixture with a third unstamped scenario recorded the stamp and halted there for differing item identities; no pin or checklist effect appeared.

items.name: A failing self-check fails the cycle at the fence, and the run with it
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: A self-check exiting 1 with golden checklist differs produced a failed fence-stage cycle with reason harness-self-check-failed and that detail. Its last effect result was self-check, with no fence or regenerate effect.

items.name: A check the self-check skips is recorded as a listed skip
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: The passing self-check printed SKIP bb-tools; the recorded harness-self-check-passed event listed bb-tools and its effect detail named it.

items.name: A fenced path that matches nothing fails the cycle at the fence
items.rule: The fence builds the clean room of the cut and proves it, as legacy fence.sh does
items.evidence: Fencing impl and absent harness/cycles recorded a fenced-path-matched-nothing refusal followed by fail-cycle, with the cycle failed at fence for fence-refused; no builder ran.

items.name: The fresh builder sees the clean room of one commit with no fenced path
items.rule: The fence builds the clean room of the cut and proves it, as legacy fence.sh does
items.evidence: The builder recorded one commit, the plan and configuration, an empty impl directory, and no fenced paths in git objects. Its provided-runtime gitlink retained mode 160000 and the exact cut object id.

items.name: Each regenerate runs one builder session and waits for it
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: The builder launched twice with different session identities, and a failed gate separated regenerate from repair. The stub did not record its first exit and second start times, so the required non-overlap was not directly observed.

items.name: A builder that exits non-zero but leaves a candidate is gated
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: The builder copied a green HTTP candidate and exited 1; regenerate recorded its digest and the gate and cycle passed.

items.name: A builder that leaves nothing fails the cycle at regenerate
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: The builder exited 0 leaving the scope empty; the run recorded fail-cycle, no regenerate effect, and failed at regenerate for candidate-not-regenerated.

items.name: A builder that outlives the regenerate timeout is stopped and the cycle fails for its budget
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: A builder sleeping 30 seconds with a 2-second regenerate budget led to a regenerate-stage budget failure. The fixture did not record the builder process identity or establish that it was stopped, so that Then was not observed.

items.name: Something answering on the port is a gate refusal, and three in a row fail the cycle
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: An HTTP server occupied the configured port; three gate refusals for seam-answered-before-boot were each followed by gate-refusal, the cycle failed for infrastructure, and the candidate launch marker was absent.

items.name: A red suite fails the attempt before the candidate is booted
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The red suite produced a gate-attempt-failed event for suite-red; the launch marker was absent and the cycle failed at gate for gate-attempts-exhausted.

items.name: A candidate with no launch entrypoint fails the attempt for a missing contract
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The candidate had test.sh but no start.sh; attempt 1 recorded gate-attempt-failed with reason contract-missing.

items.name: A served page without the marker fails the attempt for its identity
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: A green candidate served a page without the configured sauna marker; its single gate attempt recorded identity-probe-failed.

items.name: What a builder writes after it ended does not reach the gate
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: A background writer changed the builder room suite to exit 1 after the builder exited; the gate passed the copy and its install and regenerate digests matched.

items.name: A repair builder sees the previous candidate and the gate evidence, read-only
items.rule: A failed gate attempt is repaired by a fresh builder that sees only the previous candidate and the gate's evidence
items.evidence: Attempt 1 failed suite-red and repair recorded verification-repair naming that evidence root. The repair room held the clean room, previous candidate and gate evidence, and writes into both latter directories were denied.

items.name: Three failed attempts fail the cycle, no fourth builder is launched, and nothing is graded
items.rule: A failed gate attempt is repaired by a fresh builder that sees only the previous candidate and the gate's evidence
items.evidence: Three red candidate suites caused three builder launches and gate-attempts-exhausted; the run recorded no file-verdicts effect and the model log contained only the render request.

items.name: An item the judge did not score is Measurement's to record as unreached
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: Researcher code branched on the item and threw for 01-002. Only 01-001 was filed, Measurement marked 01-002 unreached, and the cycle passed with one of two.

items.name: A run that ended stays as it ended
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: R-1 failed at fence and R-2 halted at checklist; progress read again after five seconds remained identical for both, including their effect results.

items.name: Reading a run's progress changes nothing
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: After a passed HTTP cycle, two run-progress queries returned identical results and status passed.

items.name: The identity probe is handed the served URL, and passes a candidate that serves the marker
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: A probe accepting only one URL argument with the configured port and marker passed, and the run passed its cycle.

items.name: A candidate whose suite writes inside its own directory passes the gate
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: A suite creating and removing a directory inside impl passed the gate; the install and regenerate candidate digests matched.

items.name: A skipped check is recorded with the whole text after SKIP
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: The passing self-check printed the legacy SKIP line; its recorded event listed, and effect detail preserved, the entire text after SKIP.

items.name: A stdio candidate whose suite, identity probe and store check pass passes the gate
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: With stdio and no configured port, a passing suite, probe and store check recorded gate-attempt-passed with budget 30, one poll, answer on poll 1 and the probe text; the cycle passed without a gate refusal.

items.name: The identity probe is handed the gate room's launch entrypoint, the boot budget and the gate's store, and the store check reads that store
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: The stdio probe received the absolute gate-room start.sh path and 30; its GATE_STORE was in the evidence directory outside the gate room, no LOYLY_ variable was present, and the store check received that same path.

items.name: A red stdio suite fails the attempt before the identity probe, and the suite is handed no store
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: A red stdio suite recorded suite-red; its captured environment had neither GATE_STORE nor LOYLY_ variables, and neither probe nor store check ran.

items.name: An identity probe that fails fails the attempt for its identity, and the store is not checked
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: The stdio probe exited 1 with the specified boot-budget text; gate-attempt-failed carried identity-probe-failed and that text, and the store check did not run.

items.name: A store check that fails fails the attempt for its identity, with the store check's output as the detail
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: The passing probe was followed by a failing store check; the gate recorded identity-probe-failed with its FAIL event 7 detail and the cycle exhausted its gate attempts.

items.name: A stdio candidate reads the spec beside it in the gate room
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: The stdio suite required plan/01-demo/spec.feature beside it and passed; the install and regenerate candidate digests matched.

items.name: A stdio run whose store check cannot be started halts at the gate
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: With a green stdio suite and passing probe but no store-check command, the run halted at gate for effect-could-not-run and recorded no gate effect.

items.name: The harness digest of a stdio run covers the store-check command
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: Two stdio runs on one store with store-check command texts ending one and two both recorded passing first self-checks, with distinct harness digests.

items.name: A slice that is a symbolic link in the plan is read at its target
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: The cut linked plan/01-a to ../spec/a; stamping recorded both items and the checklist named them under plan/01-a, with no halt.

items.name: The configuration's plan slices select what is stamped and checklisted
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: With slices 01 and 02 present and PLAN_SLICES=02, the only stamp was slice 02 and the checklist contained only 02-001.

items.name: Each builder is handed the configured builder image, and each regenerate names the image and its digest
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: Both builder launches received the builder-clojure image as their third argument; regenerate and repair details both named that image and the same SHA-256 digest.

items.name: A start whose configured builder image is not in the builder images directory is refused
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: A configured builder-clojure absent from the images directory caused builder-image-missing; R-1 was absent and no builder launched.

items.name: Two runs on one store compare the second cycle with the first
items.rule: Measurement keeps its history across runs on the one store, so a scoreboard compares a cycle with the last measured cycle of its selection
items.evidence: Two passing runs shared one store; C-2 scoreboard named C-1 as previous, and R-2 recorded a stamp effect with no new identity events.

items.name: An identity probe that reads a file beside it in the cut passes a candidate that serves the marker
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The cut probe read its sibling configuration relative to itself and verified the served marker; the gate passed and the install and regenerate digests matched.

items.name: A gate command that exits 0 passes the attempt with the budget, the poll and the probe line it printed
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: The gate command ran once in the project repo with a cut tree missing impl, a matching candidate copy and an empty evidence directory. The gate recorded budget 10, 20 polls, answer on 3 and ledger answered as itself; the candidate launch marker was absent.

items.name: A gate command that exits 1 naming a reason fails the attempt with that reason, and the repair builder is handed its evidence
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: The first command gate recorded suite-red with detail 3 of 65 tests failed; the repair room contained its evidence file with writes denied, and the second gate passed.

items.name: A gate command whose last line is a refusal to grade is a gate refusal, and three in a row fail the cycle
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: The gate command returned seam-answered-before-boot three times; each refusal was followed by a gate-refusal effect and the cycle failed at gate for infrastructure.

items.name: A gate command whose last line names no code the runner reads halts the run at the gate
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: The unrecognized infrastructure line halted at gate with no gate or fail-cycle effect and no cycle, but its detail was prefixed "Gate could not run: ", rather than the specified exact detail.

items.name: The harness digest covers the gate command, and is unchanged when none is handed in
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: Three passed runs with no gate command, gate-a, and gate-b recorded distinct harness digests; the first matched an independent SHA-256 over config bytes, self-check command text, and probe bytes in order.

items.name: Each effect a run records lies inside the leaf of the tree named for that effect
items.rule: The run is one ORC tree, cycle.v1, and each effect the runner performs is a leaf of its own
items.evidence: The run passed with eleven effect results. The Grain event-store checker verified every effect-recorded event lay in its named leaf of the cycle or a delegated child tick.

items.name: A candidate that refuses its first three requests is answered on a later poll, its margin 20 less that poll
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The server returned 503 to its first three requests; the gate passed on poll 5 of 20 with budget 10 and recorded boot margin 15.

items.name: Each gate attempt runs as a child tick of its own of the workflow "cycle-runner/gate-attempt.v1"
items.rule: A gate attempt is one subtree, delegated once per attempt
items.evidence: The two attempt ticks are distinct children of cycle.v1 and repair for attempt 2 is in attempt 1. The gate effect leaves instead ran in separate gate-probe.v1 grandchildren, not in the required gate-attempt.v1 ticks.

items.name: A copy of the candidate in a folder of its own, with no spec around it, runs a cycle
items.rule: The runner carries its own event model, as its room gave it
items.evidence: A candidate copy in a temporary directory outside any .pi ancestor ran the green HTTP fixture; attempt 1 and the cycle passed. The temporary directory was removed after profiling.

items.name: The judge scores each item in a child tick of its own, the scores are filed as scored, and the run passes as its cycle passes
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The two judge replies produced 1.0 for checklist/01-001 and 0.0 for checklist/01-002 in distinct grade.v1 child ticks of the cycle tick. Measurement filed booked and no receipt as one pass of two, and the cycle passed.

items.name: Each item's grading starts with no other item's evidence
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The first researcher returned E-ONE; the first judge request contained it, while neither the second researcher nor the second judge request contained E-ONE.

items.name: The researcher is given the item, the seam and the event model, and a shell in the grading room only
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The researcher shell returned Linux, its grading room and only its own room above it. Its first model request contained only the item shape and lacked the scenario and the unique seam and event-model text required by this scenario.

items.name: A judge reply with the level of a pass and no reasoning scores nothing, and the item is filed unreached
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The second judge supplied level 2 and feedback without reasoning; progress and the Grain profile showed only one judge score, and Measurement filed 01-002 unreached with one of two passing.

items.name: A sealed grader whose digest the run did not approve halts the run before the cycle
items.rule: A run grades only with the approved sealed grader
items.evidence: The run approved r-1 while the rubric digest was different; it halted at grader with grader-not-approved naming that digest and recorded no self-check or fence. No builder was launched.

items.name: No item scored fails the score stage, and the run fails with its cycle
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: Researcher requests failed; file-verdicts was refused zero-verdicts, fail-score-stage was recorded, and the cycle failed at score for score-stage-failed without another builder launch.

items.name: A runner stopped while a builder session runs resumes the run, and the session with it
items.rule: A run stopped with its runner resumes where it stopped
items.evidence: The runner and sleeping builder were killed five seconds into the first session; a restart on the same store resumed and passed. The builder launched twice with the same session identity, and progress held one each of stamp, pin, checklist, first self-check, fence and regenerate.

items.name: The builder's instruction is the rendered text, and the repair's adds only the closing paragraph
items.rule: The builder instruction is rendered by the model, and the builder is handed nothing more
items.evidence: The stub rendered the prescribed builder-instruction marker containing INSTRUCTION-7. The first instruction file included the literal marker line rather than exactly INSTRUCTION-7; the repair appended a paragraph to that same incorrect text.

items.name: A render the model does not reply to halts the run before any builder
items.rule: The builder instruction is rendered by the model, and the builder is handed nothing more
items.evidence: The model returned HTTP 500 for render; the run halted at render for effect-could-not-run with no regenerate, fail-cycle, cycle, or builder launch.

items.name: Reading a running run shows its tick and the leaves it completed
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: During the sleeping builder, progress showed R-1 running with its tick identity, completed fence and render nodes, and regenerate running last.
